title: Gusttavo Lima stirs up Barretos with pickup truck arrival and campsite downtime
seoTitle: Gusttavo Lima stirs Barretos with pickup truck arrival
subtitle: The singer returned to the main stage of the Festa do Peão de Barretos after three years, sparking major buzz.
excerpt: Gusttavo Lima made his presence felt at Festa do Peão de Barretos, sparking searches after arriving in a brand-new pickup and camping with his family.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Gusttavo Lima's participation in the Festa do Peão de Barretos shook up the internet and put the singer among the most searched topics. The artist returned to the event's main arena after three years and drew attention by arriving in an unreleased Volkswagen pickup truck.

Return to the main stage and repertoire of hits

The show marked the first of two performances scheduled for the singer in this edition of the festival. The performance began with a guitar solo and the traditional announcement paying respect to the "Embaixador" (Ambassador), bringing together hits like Balada, Ficha Limpa, Bloqueado, and Cem Mil.

Arrival in a new pickup truck and market repercussions

The singer's entry into the arena took place aboard a Volkswagen Tukan in Canary Yellow, marking one of the first public appearances of the vehicle without camouflage. The moment sparked buzz because the artist had previously served as an ambassador for BYD and lent his name to a special series of the brand.

Sunday of rest and leisure at the campsite

After the show and the after-party on the event grounds, the singer and his wife, Andressa Suita, took advantage of Sunday to rest at the Parque do Peão campsite. The leisure moments included naps in hammocks, horseback riding, and playing with their children in the motorhome setup assembled at the site.

Performance marked by political moments

During the broadcast of the show, part of the crowd booed President Lula, who was not present at the venue—an episode that was broadcast live on television. The performance was attended by political figures linked to the right, reinforcing the artist's political alignment.

With information from VEJA, G1, Motor1.com Brasil.
